official_description:
The Prophet-6 is Dave Smith’s tribute to the analog polysynth that started it all—the Sequential Prophet-5. But it’s not simply a reissue of a classic. Rather, it’s the result of years of research and development and features enhancements such as studio-quality effects, a polyphonic step sequencer, an arpeggiator, and more. The Prophet-6 offers the warm, punchy sound of the original Prophet-5 with the reliability and stability of a modern instrument.

At its heart are two newly-designed discrete voltage-controlled oscillators (plus sub-oscillator) per voice. These are coupled with a resonant, 4-pole analog filter inspired by the original Prophet-5 filter. It features continuously variable waveshapes, providing a broad palette of tonal possibilities. Digital effects include classic reverb, delay, chorus, and phase shifter, as well as a vintage-style distortion. A separate, dedicated reverb is also included.
